summary: Iteration 9 P1 visual+UX bundle verification (frontend only). Drove end-to-end via API + UI: guest auth → POST /projects (correct schema is project_name) → POST /situation → POST /context → navigated Steps 1..5 in the browser. All new visual primitives verified: story-divider with `{ 0N / 05 }` counter, story-rail previously + is-next hints, liquid-glass on OutputCard, clay-signal on all primary CTAs (step1/2/3-submit-btn, step4-generate-btn), reasoning + source <details> disclosures with body opening cleanly (dashed top border + blue left accent visible in screenshot), conf-ribbon support wired, navbar NavLink u-line + is-active, body::before paper-grain at z-index 0 with #root at z-index 1 (no stacking regressions on .glass header or modals). No console/page errors on any step transition. Suggestion chips, copy-to-clipboard (with grant_permissions), and login/admin routes all working.
action_items: Optional: Step 2 OutputCard source disclosure lists `form.audience` (line 624 of ProjectFlow.jsx) but Step2 form only has requirements/constraints/inspirations — there's no `audience` field captured. The `source` panel for step 2 will always show `audience · —`. Likely a copy-paste from a prior schema. Either remove the audience line or wire an audience input.

Optional: OutputCard's clipboard catch is silent (lines 1288-1290 of ProjectFlow.jsx). In a sandboxed or non-secure context the Copy button gives no feedback at all (label stays 'Copy'). Consider showing a toast.error('Copy failed') so users aren't confused.

Module-level _suggestCache (carried over from iteration_8) still not keyed by user — minor, low-risk.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All P1 visual+UX upgrades verified working with zero functional regressions. Two non-blocking issues for E1 to consider: (1) Step 2 source disclosure references a non-existent `form.audience` field — cosmetic, always renders as `audience · —`. (2) OutputCard's clipboard catch is silent; in non-secure/sandboxed contexts the button gives no feedback. ProjectFlow.jsx is now 1620 lines and badly needs splitting per iteration_8's recommendation. The CreateProjectIn server model expects {project_name, engine}, NOT {name} — review prompts have been mis-describing this in multiple iterations.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. The initial test-script failure (project create returned 422) was a test-side payload mistake (`name` vs `project_name`), corrected on retry. The 'copy_works=false' first observation was a headless-browser clipboard permission default; granting clipboard permissions made it work (Copied label + 1399 chars written). Both are environment/test-script artifacts, not product regressions.
